changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.7 - Model-Aware Auto-Compaction, 250k Context Ceiling & Overflow Recovery
changes: Wired model-aware auto-compaction honoring enable_compaction (~65% of model context, capped at 250k tokens on 1M+ windows like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Gemini)
Connected KV-cache-friendly warm-prefix LLM summarization (with deterministic 8-section fallback) and auto-compacts conversation history beyond 24 turns instead of dropping turns silently
Scaled intra-turn tool pruning thresholds proportionally per model and added automatic context_length_exceeded overflow recovery

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.6 - Bundle WebView2Loader.dll in Windows Installer & Portable ZIP
changes: Embedded WebView2Loader.dll inside Unjess-Setup.exe so Unjess.exe launches cleanly after installation without missing DLL errors
Added dynamic Windows Known-Folder Desktop shortcut resolution (supports OneDrive Desktop redirection) and explicit install path confirmation
Published self-contained Unjess-Portable-win64.zip with Unjess.exe, WebView2Loader.dll, unjessd.exe, and unjess-cli.exe side-by-side

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.5 - Fresh Desktop Shell Build, Resource Version & Installer Sync
changes: Rebuilt Unjess.exe desktop shell and embedded UI fallback from current source instead of legacy v2.9.0/v3.0.0 assets
Updated Windows PE resource version metadata in Unjess.exe, unjessd.exe, and unjess-cli.exe from v2.9.6/v3.0.4 to v3.0.5
Synchronized installer scripts, version manifests, and Caddy/unjess.si release redirects with SHA-256 verified v3.0.5 binaries

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.4 - Ollama API UI Rename & Provider Selection Persistence Fix
changes: Renamed 'Ollama Cloud' labels to 'Ollama API' across Settings, model selectors, and backend model discovery
Fixed setModel() and Save All Settings resetting Active LLM Provider from ollama-api back to local ollama when selecting hosted Ollama API models
Preserved ollama-api selection across syncs/saves when an Ollama API key is configured, and added automatic :cloud fallback to OllamaAPIBaseURL when local Ollama is offline

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.3 - Ollama Cloud Routing & Live Model Discovery Fix
changes: Preserved explicit ollama-api provider in DetectProvider so :cloud and hosted Ollama Cloud models route to OllamaAPIBaseURL instead of local Ollama or Qwen
Added live Ollama Cloud (/api/tags) Bearer-authenticated model discovery and normalized Ollama Cloud base URL handling
Added dedicated Ollama Cloud Base URL Fetch button and accurate per-endpoint model counts in Settings

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.2 - Prototype Rewrite in Go and Rust Wry
changes: Go daemon (unjessd) and Rust Wry desktop wrapper with ~10 MB combined footprint
Multi-provider routing: local/cloud Ollama and direct provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini)
ReAct agent loop with fuzzy JSON argument auto-repair for common LLM syntax slip-ups
Model Context Protocol (MCP) client and custom skills execution
Persistent file-based workspace memory and session tracking
